title: What
label: Dump Valve

type.basis: Oriental chimes over dense bass make it the strongest candidate here, but no source calls it sino-grime by name. Left as a candidate until the panel decides.

sound.text: Frieze: oriental chimes reminiscent of Ryuichi Sakamoto over a dense, smog-thick bass.
Complex: a 'warping digital flute' from the Plugsound software series.

context.text: Frieze calls it 'perhaps Dump Valve's definitive release' and its influence on South London dubstep 'immeasurable'.
Dump Valve was DJ Target's label, set up in 2001 by the Pay As U Go Cartel selector.
Recalling early grime's innovations, Slimzee lists 'What' alongside 'I Luv U' and 'Jam Hot'.

rels.other: Digital Mystikz – 'Misty Winter' (2006), which frieze calls almost a remix of 'What'
Shots – 'Ghost EP' (Dump Valve), which frieze says keeps the oriental flavour of 'What'

uncertainty: Neither the catalogue number nor the original format is confirmed: the Juno page is the reissue. The year 2004 comes from frieze only. A candidate for the 'sino-grime' coding (oriental chimes), but no source calls 'What' sinogrime by name. RADII says Kode9 'reportedly coined' 'Sinogrime' with his 2005 Sinogrime Minimix (https://radii.co/?p=17640).
tracklist: Reissued about 2014 as a limited, hand-numbered 12" in the Rinse 20th-anniversary series, backed with Wizzbit (Geeneus alias) 'Jam Hot'.
